writeup: Caitec's Nala Cat Tunnel Bed (model 20020) combines a plush cabana bed with a tunnel and a play ball at each opening, and it folds flat when you need to store it. Woot has it brand new for $19.99, while That Pet Place charges $62.09 and Caitec's own site lists it at $68.99. Stock is very thin, with only one left at last check.
